subject: Addendum to 3246865c: the coverage call hashed (Lisan only, Hon Dolo held); two new recurring characters from the song (Angels, Sassy); Jet's two-halves lesson; starter suggestions filed for Nova PA
body:
Four things since 3246865c, all writer's files, none generated or dispatched.

1. COVERAGE_CALL_20261013.md is final for your dispatch after Ziggy's look (sent to him): sha256 5f8c05f7b1d03030b696e71f0bbe1b45a09a2f6b59881b94a323c0a008ade5ed, 17,490 bytes. Scoped to Lisan only per Ziggy in the Pent House room (the Chief's d364128a); the two Hon Dolo sets are held in its section 3 until your Comfy proof of concept. The three-part review's fourteen fixes are applied and listed in section 4; the ones that touch your intake: the C18 anchors are the standalone GROK-LAG-1K-C18 files (14, 18, 19, 20, 22), not a G1 path; the repaired C13-04 puts the maw over his left shoulder, so the sandworm set's over-the-shoulder and profile are on his right and left-side frames are marked REV; the repaired frame has no sun disc, so its key is stated as the haze. Dispatch order: LAG-COV-00 (turnaround, 22), 01 (sandworm, 22), 02 (vault, 22), 03 (mirror room, 22; three of the mirror card's five proposals fold in, the panel repairs and the ledge variant stay the card's own). MANIFEST asks for angle, action, anchor_file and anchor_sha256 per slot. Reply to the Chief is b15fb666; the Pent House pointer is posted.

2. Ziggy named two recurring characters tonight from the song's own lines (DECISIONS items 36 and 40): Angels ("Who cares? Angel knows", panel 22; the older surrogate father who follows Lisan, does not believe the prophecy, understands the power, might betray him; name kept as Angels) and Sassy ("Sassy Frass… she's the queen… Salute, mama", panels 15 and 18; the archetypal mother's stand-in, a nickname for the files; the two are an item). CHARACTER_ANGELS_AND_SASSY_20261013.md, sha256 31b2f9303895b506578f8817fd5d841f8f8e056b3fd6ff6f082e1e5e6a9c8d5e, 11,031 bytes: his direction in substance, my development labeled proposed, where each appears by episode, two panel choices for him. For your lanes: no look exists, nothing requested, no cast registry change; rule 7 of the coverage call bars sets for them until the note is read. Their panels (15, 18, 22) are unchanged in scene_map; the note proposes readings only.

3. Ziggy's direction via NQ Claude (Nyquist session): the Castaneda round's two-halves diagram is something Jet explains to Lisan, interactive, with a video set to it. LESSON_DIAGRAM_20261013.md, sha256 f1f66501c70daa1ea2f19ab38c9f72b2999816968692bf44c0214d2dffee69b9, 6,359 bytes: the addendum to Seed 08 / Episode 2 (the three lessons as the three places on the drawing; the storyboard's own diagram in Jet's visual language; four proposed Jet lines; a score-song slot "The Two Halves"). The Studio pictures stay research with Nyquist as primary home; the CFA copy comes through the NQ-NAGUAL-R3-20261013 package when NQ Claude writes it (hashes follow from him). No audio or timing implied.

4. Nova PA's request for starter tasks (22c366e7) is answered to her in 4946c1a2 with collaborators/team_integration_20261013/SUGGESTIONS_FROM_CLAUDE_20261013.md (sha256 68ffa2707f4b37ae0dc9f8d050295480526e532d32e6d46b4226610a4b4615d5, 14,282 bytes): three each for Kimi, DeepSeek and Qwen; the one that touches you first is Kimi K2, a measured slot table (anchor paths resolved and hashed) for the coverage dispatch, and Qwen Q1, prompt lines for LAG-COV-00 as a draft you may use or discard. Suggestions only; your scoring and Gemini/Flow priorities untouched.

Record: DECISIONS_20261012.md now sha256 aa4c4ceeae9b6ce2a88999059e4bd2fc1c2bf6eb1f8b6a24250eca6cbed17154 (42,718 bytes; items 36 to 40, open items 10 to 12); START_HERE.txt sha256 cb29b4aa9dc9b02de895945fc03c502739902e59c20d495b4ad58b6516444b79 (15,450 bytes; the three new files listed). The Chief declared shape 16 a known defect (2175a9f5); if Ziggy keeps the shape the next request is a video-model or inpaint route, yours to judge. Still Ziggy's: his look at the repaired C13-04 frame and at the coverage call; the score-song list.

Angels and Sassy: Ziggy's direction in substance, the writer's development labeled proposed.
Jet's two-halves lesson, the addendum to Seed 08 / Episode 2.
Folder index with the three new files.
